name: Latest flood sensor readings over a named Chesapeake area
description: Gather the most recent public water-level readings over a named Chesapeake Bay area: NWS flood categories from NOAA NWPS gauges, NOAA CO-OPS tide station levels compared with their flood thresholds, and USGS gage height and water surface elevation. Only the latest reading per sensor is returned.
planner_guidance: Use flood_sensors to see current water levels and any gauges at action stage or above in a named area of the Chesapeake Bay.
Each area can be queried once per run. Readings are live at run time, so two runs at different times return different values.
A flood category comes from NWS or NOAA thresholds for that gauge. USGS readings have no thresholds here and carry no flood status.

arguments.name: area
arguments.description: A named area. Each area is a fixed approximate bounding box recorded in the result.

sources: NOAA NWS National Water Prediction Service gauges API (api.water.noaa.gov/nwps/v1)
NOAA CO-OPS Data API and Metadata API (api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov)
USGS Water Data OGC API, latest-continuous collection (api.waterdata.usgs.gov)

limitations: Recent readings are provisional and may be revised or removed by NOAA or USGS.
Values use different datums: CO-OPS readings and thresholds are in feet above station datum, NWPS stages use each gauge's datum, and USGS elevations use NAVD88. Do not compare values across services.
An out_of_service or stale gauge is missing data, not evidence that no flooding is occurring.
The area is an approximate bounding box. Street flooding between gauges, rainfall flooding and community sensor networks such as StormSense are not covered.
These readings are not forecasts or official flood warnings; consult the National Weather Service for warnings.

policy_constraints.attribution: Water levels and flood categories from NOAA NWS National Water Prediction Service and NOAA CO-OPS; continuous values from the USGS Water Data APIs.
